subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable message presentation/message-tool multi-select contract now, and what selected-values callback shape should it expose across Slack, Discord, Telegram, and fallback channels?
rationale: The remaining work changes public message-tool and Plugin SDK semantics across multiple channel render/callback paths, so automation should not choose the API shape alone.

options.title: Add shared portable multi-select
options.body: Add an additive presentation block/tool schema with min/max selection, typed selected-values aggregation, docs, and channel-specific rendering/fallback coverage.

options.title: Keep structured selection plugin/channel specific
options.body: Defer the portable contract and let Slack modals, Discord components, Telegram web apps, or plugins solve their own structured input flows independently.

options.title: Fold into dialog/forms design
options.body: Use a broader dialog or form API for deterministic data collection and leave message presentation unchanged until that API direction is agreed.

recommendation.title: Add shared portable multi-select
recommendation.body: Add an additive presentation block/tool schema with min/max selection, typed selected-values aggregation, docs, and channel-specific rendering/fallback coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the shared presentation contract, SDK export, docs, and channel presentation refactors touched by this decision.
